risk._daily_loss_limit_note: Set beyond ~1 sd of a normal day (sd ~$420 independent, ~$840 with intraday correlation at 100 sh/market). A tighter limit stops the strategy on noise rather than on a broken edge.

rollavg_edge._gate_note: VALIDATED gate = |z|>=zmin and ask<=max_price. require_edge adds empirical_fair-ask>=edge_min, which measures +10.15c/share but on 5x fewer shares at avg px 0.389 and with a +2.24c pre-change control -- a different (longshot) effect, not the settlement change. Keep it false until paper measures it separately.
rollavg_edge._max_price_note: Raised 0.97 -> 0.99. The 0.985-0.990 band alone holds 1.22M of the 2.6M qualifying shares and still pays +0.57c/share (hit 0.996) because the fee collapses to 0.07c up there; pre-change control in the same band is -0.64c. Capping at 0.97 refused 97.7% of strong signals (px_pass 2.3% live) and left 2.5x the shares on the table. Blended EV falls 7.37c -> 3.30c but the pool grows to $29.3K/day and markets/day 367 -> 862. NOTE the payoff shape up there is ~79:1 against: a loss costs ~98.75c/share, so the dollar cap matters more than the share cap.

_note: Settlement changed 2026-08-07 to a TRAILING TWAP at BOTH boundaries: Up iff mean(P,[t1-30,t1)) >= mean(P,[t0-30,t0)). Verified on 2,880 settled markets (0.9503 vs 0.8904 for the old rule; 82.7% correct on the 266 disagreeing markets). rollavg_edge trades the venue's failure to re-price this: +3.04c/share at |z|>=2 vs +0.19c on a pre-change control. vacuum_ladder stays off: it harvested last-second spikes, which an average neutralises.
_latency_note: Total delay = venue_hold_ms + rtt_ms. venue_hold_ms is Polymarket's own documented taker delay on crypto up/down markets, reintroduced 2026-06-05: 'the order is held for 250 ms, then validation runs again and the order is matched or placed on the book', and it cannot be cancelled inside the window. rtt_ms is OUR round trip -- run src/probe_latency.py on the trading host and set the measured p50. The old single latency_ms=150 was a guess and was less than the venue hold alone. The matching engine is in AWS eu-west-2 (London); this droplet is in North Bergen NJ, ~75ms away each way, so a London/Dublin host is worth roughly 140ms of the ~410ms total.
_fill_note: Measured, not assumed. From 26,603 recorded book snapshots, at a 400ms delay in the 0.92-0.99 band the price we aimed at is still reachable only 63-69% of the time and ~50% of the size we saw survives; the broker previously took 100% of displayed size on 96% of tries. participation=0.5 encodes the surviving-size figure. vol_participation caps the fill at a quarter of what actually PRINTED at our limit in the last vol_window_s -- a displayed ask is an offer, a print is proof somebody supplied that size. min_order_size is the venue's own orderMinSize=5 (live from gamma). reject_rate covers re-validation failures and matching-engine restarts.
